'''''Peperomia trifolia''''' is a species of plant in the [[genus]] ''[[Peperomia]]''. Its [[Endemism|native range]] covers the [[Lesser Antilles]] and [[Trinidad]].<ref name="Kew01">{{Cite POWO|id=1090908-2|title=''Peperomia trifolia''|access-date=20 May 2022}}</ref>
